title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature provides detailed logging of incoming requests, enabling better debugging and error tracking. It will log request method, URL, headers, and response status code. This improves the overall debugging experience and helps identify issues in production
testCases: Test logging for failed requests with error handling
acceptance: The request logging middleware must log all incoming requests with relevant details, handle errors without crashing the application, and provide clear logs for debugging purposes
reason: Improved debugging and error tracking capabilities are essential for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse
